Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Clearpath evaluation - success framework & ops runway

Thanks again for taking time today — good conversation. Quick post-call recap and concrete next steps to get a short evaluation (4-week) running: 

1) Goal + scope
- Objective: validate Redwood Inference as the runtime for Clearpath's AI Agent (document ingestion + query + summarization) with production-like latency and predictable cost.
- Scope: two model endpoints (1 embedding + 1 LLM), 3 representative prompt patterns (short question, long-context summarization, rerank).

2) Proposed success criteria (please confirm or propose edits)
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency < 300ms for short queries; for long-context summarization allow up to 1.2s.
- Throughput: sustain 10 req/s per endpoint during peak synthetic load with <5% error rate.
- Cost: target blended inference cost < $0.0008 per token at trial traffic (we can show runtime cost breakdown).
- Quality: response relevance >= 88% on your small evaluation set (we'll run automated evals + a 20-sample human spot-check).

3) Evaluation plan & timeline (4 weeks)
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): share dataset samples, traffic shape, and access (API keys + CIDR allowlist).
- Week 1 (smoke + baseline): deploy model variants, smoke test latency/throughput, initial cost projection.
- Week 2 (mid-trial quality pass): run batch evals; manual review on a 20-sample set.
- Week 3 (stress & scaling): throughput ramp to peak shape; verify autoscaling and KV-cache effectiveness.
- Week 4 (final readout): performance/cost/quality report and go/no-go recommendation.

4) Owners
- Ben Carter (sales): contract & commercial; single point to schedule access and engineering touchpoints.
- Jordan Blake (CS): ops onboarding, runbooks, and SLO config.
- Karthik Iyer (Solutions): infra verification, quantization/compat checks.
- Clearpath: Maya (product lead) and Devon (infra) to provide datasets, traffic shape, and review.

5) Action items for next 72h
- Clearpath: send a 1-week traffic sample + 5 representative documents for summarization (Devon/Maya).
- Redwood: share evaluation template (attached) and a proposed kickoff slot (Sep 20).

Attachments: clearpath-eval-template.xlsx (evaluation matrix + token accounting).

Please reply with any edits to the success criteria above. If that all looks good I will lock the kickoff for Monday Sep 20 and share a short agenda.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172

Subject: Re: Clearpath evaluation - success framework & ops runway

Ben — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick adjustments from our product/infra side: 

- Latency: for interactive Q&A use-cases we should aim for 95th < 250ms for the short queries. If that requires a different instance class for the trial, call it out in the cost projection.
- Cost: the $0.0008/token baseline is fine as a target but note our internal threshold for evaluation acceptance is closer to $0.001/token given some pre/post processing. Wed like to see both projected blended and worst-case.
- Throughput: the 10 req/s target is representative; attaching a 24-hour traffic sample with peak windows so you can simulate (see attachment).
- Quality: wed prefer a blended metric: automated relevance + 10 human-labeled examples for final acceptance.

Also two asks before kickoff:
1) Can you confirm network allowlist steps and whether Redwood needs a VPN or just IP ranges?
2) Please include a short SOC2 data-handling blurb in the kickoff deck so our security team can pre-scan.

Attaching: clearpath-traffic-sample.json (traffic shape + typical request/response size).

Maya
Maya Holmes
Head of Product, Clearpath AI
maya.holmes@clearpath.ai

Thanks Maya — helpful notes. Quick updates and I've incorporated your asks into the evaluation plan: 

- Latency SLO updated: short queries 95th < 250ms (Redwood will include both a baseline and a tuned config). For summarization we'll hold the 1.2s bound.
- Cost reporting: we'll provide blended and worst-case cost per token in the week-1 baseline report.
- Network: Redwood supports IP allowlisting. Ill send the CIDR ranges and a short VPN option note ahead of kickoff.
- Security: Jordan will include a SOC2 handling slide in the kickoff deck.

Refined gating (concrete):
- Day 1-3 (onboarding): keys provisioned, CIDR allowlist applied, smoke tests pass.
- Day 4-7 (baseline): collect baseline latencies/cost; if 95th latency > 350ms or error rate > 7% we will identify tuning steps and re-run.
- Week 2 (quality checkpoint): automated eval + 10-sample human review; if relevance < 80% we agree to iterate on prompt/temperature but that will not itself fail the trial.
- Week 4 (final): pass/fail based on combined evaluation matrix (latency + throughput + cost + quality).

Proposed kickoff: Mon Sep 20, 10:00am PT. If that works Ill lock calendar and send the agenda.

Action items (ownership):
- Clearpath (Maya/Devon): confirm Sep 20 and upload data samples to the Drive link.
- Redwood (Ben): send CIDR ranges + attach the evaluation template (done) and draft kickoff agenda.
- Redwood (Jordan): prepare SOC2 handling slide + runbook stub.

Attaching: clearpath-eval-template.xlsx (already shared).

Best,
Ben
